_comment: Codex 会话解析的对拍场景。Node 侧生成脚本与 Rust 侧差分测试读同一文件。content 是 rollout-*.jsonl 的内容，filePath 用于推导会话编号。只放列表模式（parseSessionListContent）能覆盖到的输入。

cases.name: 标准会话：meta + 两条消息
非法 JSON 行被跳过
cases.content:
not json at all
{"timestamp":"2026-09-25T10:00:01.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"唯一消息"}]}}

cases.name: 未知类型与未知载荷被忽略
多行文本内容用换行拼接
长标题被截断
cases.content: {"timestamp":"2026-09-25T10:00:00.000Z","type":"response_item","payload":{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"这是一个非常长的标题xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx结束"}]}}

cases.name: 文件名不匹配 rollout 模式
文件里有非 ASCII 路径（Windows 风格）
十二条消息：预览被截断到 8 条
